mcpSurfaceFinding.whatExists: hauska-mcp-server is the one cross-product identity primitive today (resolveCaller's whoami branch, plan-review's mcp.mjs key forwarding). It resolves a bearer to a TENANT via GET /auth/whoami. It is not in any of this dispatch's three repos.
mcpSurfaceFinding.whatIsMissing: hauska-mcp-server has no path today that accepts a staff JWT and returns a person/role claim -- confirmed by reading every consumer of it in the three named repos (none read anything but jurisdiction_tenant off the whoami response) and by there being no local copy of hauska-mcp-server's own source in this checkout to read directly.
mcpSurfaceFinding.consequenceIfUnaddressed: A caller holding a valid staff JWT who calls hauska-mcp-server directly (as this very Claude session's own Smart_Site MCP tools do, per this program's live-MCP access) is resolved only to a tenant or refused outright -- there is no person/role check to bypass YET, but there is also no door FOR a person to go through legitimately at that layer, which will become the bypass the moment the UI-side check exists and the MCP-side one does not.
mcpSurfaceFinding.disposition: Named as an explicit gap per the dispatch's own escape valve ('name it as an explicit gap with its consequence stated'), not built here: hauska-mcp-server is owned by a different program/seat (OPS-19/OPS-23 per the canon preamble; property/substrate territory, not OPS-17 govtech), and this dispatch's repo is smartcity-dashboards plus the two sibling product repos -- editing a fourth repo outside this lane's assignment is exactly the scope-discipline this program has been burned by before. A follow-on row against hauska-mcp-server, scoped to accepting the same staff bearer this lane defines and returning the same role claim, is the concrete recommendation carried to CP2/close.
